visualCharacteristics.purpose: 2-up full-bleed photo cards with overlay text: eyebrow, heading (or logo image), description, pill CTA and optional footnote
visualCharacteristics.layout: 2 columns on desktop, stacked on mobile; text anchored bottom-left over cover-fit image
visualCharacteristics.source: https://bradescobank.com/en/ sections rc10 and rc11 (Investments, Real Estate, Credit Cards, Zelle)

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: background image cell | text cell with optional eyebrow paragraph, heading (or logo image), description, CTA link, optional footnote paragraph after the CTA

cells: Eyebrow, heading or logo image, description, CTA link, optional footnote

usage: Use for product promotion cards with a background photo and a call to action.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for photo product cards; place multiple rows in one block rather than one block per pair.
